exact_stem: On a map with a 40 ft contour interval, a trail crosses 5 contour lines over 1 cm of map distance heading north, then crosses 5 more contour lines over 4 cm heading east. All contours show increasing elevation in both directions. Which statement best describes the terrain along this trail?
exact_authored_answer: Both segments gain 200 ft, but the northward segment is much steeper than the eastward segment

segments.heading: north
segments.profile: linear and strictly increasing along this segment

segments.heading: east
segments.profile: linear and strictly increasing along this segment

continuous_terrain_witness.formula: z(x,y)=100+(195/4)*x+190*y feet; x east and y north, both in map centimetres
continuous_terrain_witness.ordinary_contours: Level sets z=40*k for integer k; no supplementary lines used.
